name: NGC 5237 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5237, a dwarf galaxy in the Centaurus A group, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5237-hubble
story: A compact dwarf galaxy in the Centaurus A group, NGC 5237 has an irregular heart wrapped in a smooth outer halo. Hubble resolves it into about a hundred thousand individual stars.

claims.text: NGC 5237 is a compact galaxy of I0 type, Cen A group member
Irregular central part and smooth periphery
About 100,000 stars resolved in Hubble ACS data from program 9771
NGC 5237 appears to be a dwarf transitional galaxy in the Cen A group; also HIPASS J1337-42
